title: Modulatory effects of pinocembrin from Nigerian propolis on IL-6, IL-1β, and adipokines in rats with chronic glucose and fructose administration
core_idea: Investigate whether pinocembrin from Nigerian propolis modulates inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, IL-1β) and adipokines associated with metabolic disturbances induced by prolonged oral glucose and fructose intake, using a four-group Wistar rat model (control; glucose/fructose; glucose/fructose plus pinocembrin; glucose/fructose plus metformin) with 8 weeks of administration followed by blood biochemical analysis.
tldr: Preclinical study testing pinocembrin's effects on cytokines and adipokines in rats exposed to chronic glucose/fructose, compared with metformin, using biochemical markers after 8 weeks.
